name: Goblin Warlord
bio: Rules the warren by fear, spite and a very large knife.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-05 ("Goblin Warlord villain", rigged and animated on Meshy (Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains, where it has them, folded into the hands and refitted by hands.mjs; its clips not used)). A green goblin in spiked leather armour and a tattered cloak hung with skulls (the owner's "fantasy": Knights & Legends). Standard size: a warlord, not a little goblin (the owner may prefer small, as goblins usually are). Not Snikkit (Goblin Mischief replaces Snikkit). Display name a placeholder for the owner. Licence recorded as owned (no metadata says otherwise); the owner to confirm, and if it is a Meshy community model, switch to CC0 with its author and post URL.

source.author: the owner, on their Meshy subscription
